title: Invariant constant-rank strata of a finite locally free affine groupoid
statement: Let $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $R=\operatorname{Spec}B$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $s,t:R\to U$, $e:U\to R$, $i:R\to R$, and $c:R\times_{s,U,t}R\to R$ [def-pc-fibre-product] define a groupoid: functorially in every test scheme $H$, they make $U(H)$ the objects and $R(H)$ the arrows, with source $s$, target $t$, identity $e$, inverse $i$, and composition $c$. Assume $s,t$ are finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. There is a finite set $I\subset\mathbf Z_{\ge1}$ and a disjoint open-and-closed decomposition $U=\coprod_{r\in I}U_r$ into nonempty affine open subschemes such that $R_r=s^{-1}(U_r)=t^{-1}(U_r)$ is affine, all the structure maps restrict to a groupoid on $(U_r,R_r)$, and $s_r,t_r:R_r\to U_r$ are finite locally free of degree $r$. If $U$ is empty, $I$ is empty. Here degree $r$ means that every scheme-theoretic fibre has coordinate algebra of dimension $r$ over the residue field of its base point.
